scenicChapters.title: Passo dello Spluga
scenicChapters.narrative: For 39 km this is Passo dello Spluga, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Passo dello Spluga
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2066 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

san-bernardino-pass-road.story: 93 km one way from Thusis - plan on about 1 h 36 of riding. The stops in between: Splugen and San Bernardino Pass. The highest point is about 2,100 m. San Bernardino Pass is open in summer only - check it is open before you set off. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
